Introducing a revolutionary eyelash treatment designed to enhance the length and appearance of your eyelashes. LATISSE™ solution is a prescription treatment for hypotrichosis and is used to grow eyelashes, making each eyelash longer, thicker, and darker. Hypotrichosis is another name for having inadequate or too few eyelashes. As part of our comprehensive vision care services, we also offer [[a href="/eye-care-services/eye-exams/"]]Routine eye exam[[/a]] appointments and [[a href="/eye-care-services/lasik-refractive-surgery-co-management/"]]LASIK & Refractive Surgery Co-Management[[/a]] to help patients maintain optimal eye health and achieve their visual goals.
LATISSE™ is believed to grow eyelashes in two ways: By increasing the length of the eyelash growth phase By increasing the number of eyelashes in this growth phase.

LATISSE™ is a daily eyelash solution you apply each evening to the base of your upper eyelashes. LATISSE™ users begin to see eyelash growth at 4 weeks with full results after 16 weeks. The growth is gradual overnight, over time.
The most common side effects after using LATISSE™ solution are an itching sensation in the eyes and/or eye redness.

To find out if LATISSE™ enhancement for eyelashes is right for you, call or visit [[a href="/hours-location/"]]Briargrove Eye Center[[/a]] for an expert LATISSE™ assessment. Our experienced team can help determine whether this prescription treatment is the right option for achieving fuller, longer-looking lashes. Read more about LATISSE™.
